issue_title: Ice buildup in freezer and warm fridge section
issue_description: Freezer compartment has thick frost accumulation on evaporator cover plate. Lower fridge section is warm (around 14C). Fan was making a grinding noise before stopping completely.
transcript: Customer mentions the fridge stopped blowing cold air into the bottom section about 3 days ago.
image_descriptions: Heavy frost and rime ice encasing the evaporator fan shroud and vent.

issue_title: Compressor clicking off and not cooling
issue_description: Compressor attempts to start every 2 minutes with a distinct click, hums for 4 seconds, and clicks off. Food in both compartments thawing.
image_descriptions: Rear mechanical compartment shows compressor warm to touch with inverter PCB relay board.

issue_title: Water pooling under vegetable crisper drawers
issue_description: Clear water consistently pools underneath bottom crisper bins every morning. Freezer works fine and temperatures are within range.

issue_title: Food freezing solid in refrigerator fresh food compartment
issue_description: Fresh vegetables, eggs, and milk on middle shelves are freezing rock solid. Temperature dial set to medium.

issue_title: Excessive buzzing noise from rear bottom
issue_description: Loud buzzing and rattle coming from compressor area whenever unit runs. Quiets down when pressing against rear metal cover.

issue_title: High temperature alert beeping continuously
issue_description: Control panel beeping and flashing door warning even when doors are firmly closed. Internal light remains on intermittently.

issue_title: Inverter error code H21 displayed
issue_description: Digital panel shows error code H21. Defrost cycle not completing automatically.

issue_title: Water not draining from drum, OE error code
issue_description: Front-load washer stops mid-cycle with drum full of soapy water. Display shows OE fault code. Filter pump makes buzzing sound but does not evacuate water.
image_descriptions: Front display panel illuminated with OE error code; water visible through glass door.

issue_title: Error 4C / 4E water supply failure
issue_description: Machine hums for 3 minutes at start of program, no water enters the soap dispenser drawer, then displays 4C.

issue_title: Violent shaking and UE unbalance code during spin
issue_description: Drum knocks heavily against side cabinet during final spin cycle and drops back to 400 RPM before error UE triggers.

issue_title: Error E18 drain pump timeout
issue_description: Program halts before rinse phase. Sump area filled with water. Error E18 shown on LED indicator.

issue_title: Drum does not spin during wash cycle
issue_description: Water fills normally, but pulsator only twitches back and forth slightly with low electrical hum. Motor does not rotate drum.

issue_title: Error E20 / E21 draining failure
issue_description: Water remains in tub after wash cycle. Washer beeps and terminates cycle displaying E20.

issue_title: Grinding noise during wash agitation
issue_description: Loud metallic ratcheting sound whenever the agitator switches direction during wash cycle. Spin cycle is relatively quiet.

issue_title: AC not cooling, timer light blinking orange
issue_description: Indoor air conditioner blows room-temperature fan air. After 5 minutes, cooling shuts off and the orange timer indicator blinks continuously. Diagnostics remote shows fault code H16 / F99.
transcript: Technician note: Customer reports outdoor compressor stops spinning after clicking twice.
image_descriptions: Indoor wall unit timer LED blinking orange; no frost on copper joints.

issue_title: Louver flaps stuck and blinking green LED
issue_description: Horizontal airflow swing blade is drooping halfway open and fails to sweep. Motor gears make clicking noise when turning on unit.

issue_title: Water dripping heavily down interior wall under fan coil
issue_description: Cooling works well, but water leaks profusely from the bottom right corner of indoor casing, soaking wallpaper and skirting board.

issue_title: Outdoor compressor shuts down after 3 minutes
issue_description: Air blows cold momentarily, then outdoor fan and compressor cease operation simultaneously. Indoor unit keeps blowing warm air.

issue_title: Blowing ambient air, hiss sound from coil
issue_description: Air conditioner does not cool down room at all. Soft hissing noise audible near service valves of outdoor condenser.

issue_title: Error E1 indoor temperature sensor fault
issue_description: Digital display on indoor unit shows error E1 immediately upon powering on. Unit refuses to initiate cooling compressor.

issue_title: Ceiling cassette condensate water overflowing ceiling tiles
issue_description: Commercial ceiling cassette unit beeps with water level float sensor alarm. Water staining ceiling gypsum board.

issue_title: Induction hob error E9 on front left zone
issue_description: Front left cooking zone displays flashing E and 9. Other three induction zones heat normally. Touch panel sounds rapid beeps.

issue_title: Built-in oven fan runs but no heat generated
issue_description: Convection fan circulates air and clock display works, but heating element does not glow or warm up the oven cavity.

issue_title: Convection microwave stops after 23 seconds with code H98
issue_description: Microwave powers on, turntable rotates, but after 23 seconds of operation it stops dead and displays error code H98.

issue_title: Gas burner ignites while holding knob but goes out when released
issue_description: Burner produces blue flame while knob is pressed in, but flame immediately extinguishes the moment knob is released.

issue_title: Yellow sooty flame on double-ring burner
issue_description: Burner flames are tall, ragged, and bright yellow/orange, creating black carbon soot on the bottom of cooking pans.

issue_title: Digital air fryer fan spins but basket stays completely cold
issue_description: Timer counts down and fan sounds normal, but heating coil above food basket produces zero thermal heat.

issue_title: Igniter spark continues clicking continuously
issue_description: Piezo spark igniter clicks constantly at rapid pace even when both control knobs are in the OFF position. Requires battery removal to silence.

issue_title: Error E24 drainage blockage on display
issue_description: Dishwasher beeps 3 minutes before program completes. Water standing in filter well. Display shows error E24.

issue_title: Error i30 anti-flood system activated
issue_description: Dishwasher continuously runs drain pump with error i30 on screen. Cannot cancel or start new cycle until power disconnected.

issue_title: Top spray arm not spinning, dishes coming out dirty
issue_description: Wash cycle runs to completion with detergent pod dissolved, but upper rack glasses are dirty and upper spray arm is stationary.

issue_title: Range hood motor hums but blower fan will not rotate
issue_description: Touch buttons illuminate, motor emits a deep 50Hz hum, but impeller wheel remains stationary. Can be spun by hand freely.

issue_title: Heavy vibration and oil dripping into cooking area
issue_description: Cooker hood shakes entire cabinet when set to speed 3. Oil droplets leak past filter baffle down onto stovetop.

issue_title: Error E15 leak sensor triggered in bottom casing
issue_description: Tap symbol flashes on display and code E15 is displayed. Water detected inside sealed drip pan.

issue_title: Touch control panel completely unresponsive
issue_description: Power reaches appliance (LED under-lights work via physical switch), but touch controls for fan speeds 1, 2, 3 do not register touches.

issue_title: Food processor motor does not start with bowl locked
issue_description: Bowl and lid are clicked into locked position, but turning dial to speed 1 or pulse does not trigger motor.

issue_title: Stand mixer speed fluctuating erratically
issue_description: Mixer speed surges up and down uncontrollably on low settings instead of maintaining steady rpm.

issue_title: Oil leaking from planetary attachment hub
issue_description: Amber-colored liquid oil seeping out around beater planetary shaft into dough mixing bowl.

issue_title: Slow juicer auger jammed with loud screeching sound
issue_description: Auger ceased rotating when processing carrots. Reverse button clicks but auger remains immovably stuck.

issue_title: Espresso machine no pressure through portafilter
issue_description: Pump activates with normal vibration sound, but only trickles water through brew head without achieving 9 bar extraction pressure.

issue_title: Infuser brew group stuck in top position
issue_description: Machine alarm light on with red triangle. Brew group carriage jammed at upper limit switch and cannot be extracted.

issue_title: Burning smell from motor base during ice crushing
issue_description: Sharp electrical ozone and burnt carbon odor from underside vent when operating at variable speed 10.

issue_title: Ceiling fan wobbling violently at speed 3 and above
issue_description: 5-blade ceiling fan wobbles substantially at higher speeds, creating a knocking noise near the upper ceiling canopy mount.

issue_title: Ceiling fan does not respond to remote control transmitter
issue_description: Remote control has fresh batteries and LED transmits, but ceiling fan PCB does not beep or change speeds.

issue_title: Air purifier shows exclamation mark and filter code 90
issue_description: LCD screen shows continuous exclamation symbol. Airflow drops to minimum and machine refuses to heat.

issue_title: Stand fan spins very slowly and motor housing overheats
issue_description: Fan blades take nearly a minute to begin rotating and turn very sluggishly. Motor case becomes hot to the touch.

issue_title: Plasmacluster light blinking red and air smells stale
issue_description: Ionizer icon flashes red on control panel. Purifier fan still operates on medium speed.

issue_title: Fan head clicks and stutters during 90-degree oscillation
issue_description: Fan blade rotates smoothly, but oscillation mechanism jerks and makes rhythmic clicking noise at edge of swing.

issue_title: Steam generator iron spitting brown mineral water
issue_description: Soleplate spits brown calcified water and yellow flakes onto garments instead of dry continuous steam.

issue_title: No steam emitted from iron despite reservoir being full
issue_description: Iron soleplate gets hot, water pump clicks repeatedly, but zero steam exits soleplate holes.

issue_title: Cordless vacuum motor pulses on and off repeatedly
issue_description: When trigger is pulled, motor surges/pulses in rapid bursts and LCD screen prompts to clean filter.

issue_title: Robot vacuum Error 1 LiDAR turret stuck
issue_description: Robot starts mapping, rotates in place for 10 seconds, then announces Error 1 lidar turret jammed.

issue_title: Robot vacuum drives in continuous circles
issue_description: Robot moves forward 2 inches, turns sharply to the right, and repeats indefinitely until error stops operation.

issue_title: Loss of suction with high-pitched motor whine
issue_description: Suction power has dropped by 80%. Motor runs at unusually high RPM pitch and suction hose is clear.

issue_title: Audio plays normally but screen remains completely dark
issue_description: TV powers on, volume controls produce sound and menus respond, but display is pitch black. Shined flashlight reveals faint picture outline.

issue_title: Standby light blinks 3 times, TV clicks and shuts off
issue_description: Pressing power button triggers relay click, front red LED blinks 3 times, then relay clicks off without picture.

issue_title: Horizontal colored lines across lower half of screen
issue_description: Multiple static green and purple lines stretch across lower third of display panel. Image above remains clean.

issue_title: Built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth completely disconnected
issue_description: Network settings state 'Wi-Fi hardware disabled'. TV fails to detect any 2.4GHz or 5GHz wireless networks.

issue_title: Severe audio distortion and crackling from speakers
issue_description: Internal speakers emit loud buzzing and torn-paper vibration sound whenever volume exceeds 15. Optical output sounds clear.

issue_title: TV stuck in endless boot loop on Android logo
issue_description: TV powers on, displays TCL logo followed by spinning Android balls, restarts after 40 seconds, and repeats continuously.

issue_title: Strong odor of unburnt cooking gas near oven supply pipe
issue_description: Family detects pungent rotten egg gas odor filling the kitchen near the rear flexible gas hose connector. Hissing sound audible near shutoff valve.

issue_title: Electric shock felt when touching metal casing of washing machine
issue_description: User received sharp electrical shock upon touching the metal outer casing while standing barefoot on wet tile floor. Sparks observed at back panel.

issue_title: Dense black smoke and acrid burning smell billowing from AC unit
issue_description: Indoor air conditioner suddenly emitted loud pop followed by thick black smoke pouring out from blower vent. Burning plastic smell throughout room.

issue_title: Water leaking directly onto exposed wall socket and power plug
issue_description: Burst inlet hose spraying water directly into the double 13A wall socket behind the unit. Wall outlet is sizzling with water pooling around live socket.

issue_title: Cordless vacuum battery pack swollen hot and hissing
issue_description: Lithium-ion battery pack on handle has visibly bulged and cracked its plastic housing. Battery feels burning hot and emits a chemical hissing odor.

issue_title: Exposed bare live 240V copper wire hanging behind dryer drum
issue_description: Rear inspection panel vibrated loose exposing severed 240V main power cable with bare copper conductors brushing against vibrating chassis.

issue_title: Gas hob whistling loudly with continuous yellow flash and sulfur odor
issue_description: Gas connection whistling loudly under glass hob with unmistakable sulfur mercaptan smell. Gas stove won't shut off completely.

issue_title: Microwave sparking like fireworks inside cavity with scorched wall
issue_description: Violent blue electrical arcing and explosive popping sounds inside cavity. Mica waveguide cover is completely black and charred.

issue_title: AC outdoor unit capacitor exploded with loud bang and acid smell
issue_description: Outdoor condensing unit made violent gunshot bang sound followed by dielectric fluid spraying out with pungent acid smell.

issue_title: Induction glass cooktop shattered with live sparks when powered
issue_description: Cast iron pot dropped on ceramic top causing jagged glass fissure. Turning on power creates blue sparks arcing through glass crack.
